'''Jhabacc''' was a high-stakes version of<ref name="Jhabacc" /> the popular electronic card game<ref name="Sabacc">{{CSWECite|III|121|Sabacc}}</ref> [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] played at the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="Jhabacc" /> a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and gambling hall located in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of<ref name="Outlander">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="InsidetheWorlds">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Outlander" /> Popular in the private [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] rooms of the nightclub, the game was played before the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]]<ref name="Jhabacc" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}}, which includes the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref>

During a [[Local day/Legends|night]]<ref name="AotC">{{Film|II}}</ref> in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="22 BBY">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]'' depicts Jhabacc being played at the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] when [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|visited]] the establishment during the events of {{Film|II}}, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> four favored guests of the club participated in a game<ref name="InsidetheWorlds" /> of Jhabacc in one of the Outlander's private gambling rooms<ref name="Jhabacc" /> while the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] was interrogated outside the club by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="InsidetheWorlds" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jhabacc was first mentioned in ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]'', a reference book written by [[Simon Beecroft]] and [[Curtis Saxton]] and published in [[2003]].<ref name="InsidetheWorlds" /> Artist [[Hans Jenssen]] illustrated the playing of Jhabacc.<ref name="Artist">{{WebCite|url=https://www.hansjenssen.co.uk/star-wars-locations|text=''Star Wars Locations''|author=[[Hans Jenssen]]|archivedate=20190517022701}}</ref> ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', a [[2008]] reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Stephen J. Sansweet]], provided the capitalization "jhabacc."<ref name="Jhabacc" /> This article follows the original capitalization given in ''Inside the Worlds''.
